title: Professional 2026-09-20 — GaN multi-output DC power supply
goal: Evaluate the generated 1200 W DC-DC supply architecture, including its own declared output rails, feedback and controller branches. Efficiency and power feasibility are outside visual grading.

rubric.must: Every declared output rail (+12 V, +5 V, +3.3 V and +5 VSB) is visibly connected to its supplying stage.
Power paths and feedback/control paths are independently traceable without implying a false power junction.
Multiline stage labels, branch annotations and return paths remain legible at a useful viewing scale.

provenance.notes: Selected against a real first user request. Source defects are intentionally preserved. Project identity is removed; no customer IDs or private prompt text are included. These are evaluation inputs, not approved professional reference designs. Full conversation changes and domain behavior require separate review.
